transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. To start, can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brought you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because... for a really long time now, I just wake up already feeling low. It's like there's this heavy, gray feeling on me before I even get to the clinic for work, and it pretty much just follows me through the whole day.
You mentioned this has been going on for a long time—can you tell me roughly how many months or years you've been feeling this way?

It's been... about two years and two months now. It started right around the time the staffing changed at the clinic. My schedule started rotating all over the place, and, yeah, I've just felt this way ever since then.
Over these two years, have there been any stretches of time—say two weeks or more—when your mood or other symptoms became noticeably worse than your usual baseline?

Not really, no. I haven't noticed it getting a lot worse for a stretch of time like that. It's just... pretty much the exact same heavy feeling every single day. It doesn't really dip lower or anything, it just stays constantly bad.

During this two-year period, have you also been experiencing things like major changes in your sleep or appetite, trouble concentrating, loss of interest in almost everything, or thoughts of death, occurring together most days?

No, I haven't really experienced all that. My sleep and appetite are pretty much normal, and I don't have thoughts about death or anything like that. It's really just... just that constant low mood I mentioned. I haven't noticed a bunch of other stuff piling on top of it.
